packageRules.description: gvisor-tap-vsock: never back to v0.8.9, which does not build against a gvisor with the CVE-2026-96812 fix
gvisor: no digest updates; a new commit is taken by hand from its go branch
A new OVMF build invalidates recorded golden PCR values; its pull request and release note say so
prBodyNotes: **Firmware change: golden PCR values must be recorded again.** `ovmf-generic` is the OVMF build every VM boots with, and PCR 0 measures it. Golden values recorded under the current build fail every quote under this one (`golden mismatch: pcr 0`), and a VM created with attestation required never receives its user-data. After this release, record the values again for every image in use: README, section Attestation, "Recording golden values again".
